findings.highlight: Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"
findings.evidenceJa: ほら士郎、客間に案内して。前に上がった時、離れの客間に目をつけてたんだから。あ、イリヤはどこがいい？」
findings.governingReading: Rin asks to be shown to the guest room in the detached annex, which she had marked out when previously admitted into the house.
findings.explanation: A guest room Rin noticed inside the detached annex on a prior visit becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way here.
